information_state.reason_calibration_not_invalidated: No Stage C run existed. Revision 11 is an outcome-blind availability correction discovered while implementing the provider dispatch catalog. The retired endpoints could not have produced task evidence.

changes.before: The frozen Together pair named meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-Turbo and meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Turbo. Together's deprecation ledger shows those endpoints retired on 2026-02-25 and 2026-03-06, before the initial freeze.
changes.after: The Together cell uses provider-native IDs zai-org/GLM-5.3 and zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash, observed in the official serverless catalog on 2026-09-03. LiteLLM dispatch strings retain the together_ai/ prefix, and every run archives the mutable catalog observation.

changes.before: Production downgrade wiring used hard-coded one-hop strings and ratios without a common provider protocol, credential namespace, capability, output-token convention, or provenance contract.
changes.after: One versioned Rust catalog supplies candidate identity, routing group, provider protocol and namespace, capabilities, context/output limits, output-token parameter, price version, observation time, and primary sources. Python adapters reject incomplete or cross-namespace model mutations and record the selected and executed identities.

changes.before: The Python routing cost table listed Claude Haiku 4.5 at $0.80/$4.00 per million input/output tokens.
changes.after: The versioned catalog and Python observation table use Anthropic's observed official $1.00/$5.00 input/output price and retain its source. No experimental result used the stale price.

changes.before: A failed routed dispatch replayed the original request, after which sync shadow sampling could replay that same original request again.
changes.after: Sync and async dispatch mark exact-original fallback explicitly. Shadow sampling skips fallback executions, so a failed routed attempt triggers exactly one original request and records the actual executed model and fallback reason.

implementation_status.runtime_scope: canonical execution-plan identity, constrained selection, exact per-plan profiles, and provider-safe versioned model dispatch; exploration, plan-level guard attribution, diagnostics, and end-to-end evaluation remain pending

outcome_blindness_assertion: Revision 11 was frozen before any admission, calibration, pilot, or confirmatory execution. No task outcome informed the unavailable-model correction or catalog dispatch contract.
